description: Is a dependency version safe to write? Verdict on an exact version, or safe releases in a constraint ("7.x", "~=3.1"); npm, crates.io, PyPI, Go. Call BEFORE writing any version to a manifest: add, pin, upgrade, bump, downgrade.

items.description: The proposed changes to check, 1 to 25.

from.description: Exact version currently installed. Omit when adding a new dependency.

to.description: The version you intend to write ("7.5.10", "3.1.4", "v0.23.0"), "latest", or the constraint it must satisfy ("7.x", "^1.20", "=0.17", "~=3.1", ">=2,<3", "v1") to get the safe releases in it.

name: dependency_check
title: Dependency check
